Dimple says Wangchuk to end hunger strike on July 20:Reaches Jantar Mantar with MPs; says government does not care who lives or dies
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party MP Dimple Yadav reached Delhi’s Jantar Mantar on Thursday and met social activist Sonam Wangchuk, who is sitting on a hunger strike. She met him around 3:30 pm. When Dimple reached the stage, slogans of “Inquilab Zindabad” were raised. She said the government does not care about who is living or dying. She claimed that Sonam Wangchuk told her that he would end his hunger strike on July 20. Dimple said, “I want to appeal to all the youth to join the march from here to Parliament on July 20. This is a fight for your rights and dignity.” During the visit, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke said, “Dimple Yadav requested Sonam Wangchuk to end his hunger strike on July 20. She said that her party would take this fight forward in Parliament, but Sonam Wangchuk has not given any response on this yet.” Wangchuk has been demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the NEET paper leak issue. He has been on an indefinite hunger strike for the past 19 days, during which his weight has dropped by 8.9 kg. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav had also appealed to him on July 14 to end the protest. Dimple's 2 major points- ‘Fear is being created in the country’: Dimple Yadav said, “I salute Sonam Wangchuk’s hunger strike. The health of many students has deteriorated. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has provided a platform to the youth. If our youth become strong, no one can defeat them. The entire Samajwadi Party supports this. Everyone knows the condition of students and farmers in the country. An atmosphere of fear is being created.” ‘Government and BJP do not follow Gandhi’s ideals’: She said, “The government does not care who is living or dying. Such a harsh government has never existed in the country. BJP can be stopped in Uttar Pradesh through votes. They do not want to take responsibility. They do not follow Gandhi’s ideals. They only want to remain in power by using the name of Lord Ram.” 6 MPs and 1 MLA were present with Dimple Yadav Dimple Yadav was accompanied by six MPs and one MLA, including Samajwadi Party MPs Ruchi Veera from Moradabad, Dharmendra Yadav from Azamgarh, Narottam Patel from Fatehpur, Mohibullah Nadvi from Rampur, Pappu Nishad from Sant Kabir Nagar, and SP MLA Ragini Sonkar from Machhlishahr. Priya Saroj had reached Jantar Mantar a day earlier Earlier on Wednesday (July 15), SP MP Priya Saroj had reached Jantar Mantar and said, “We stand with all the youth. Do not fear anyone and do not stop. We can move forward only through struggle. I will also raise your voice in Parliament.” Akhilesh called Wangchuk to inquire about his well-being SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had posted on X on Tuesday, July 14, in support of Sonam Wangchuk. He said he spoke to Wangchuk over the phone and enquired about his health while appealing to him to end the hunger strike. Akhilesh said the country needs Wangchuk’s moral leadership and that he should recover his health before starting a new movement. He also attacked the BJP, saying issues like the NEET paper leak and Ram Temple theft reflected the government’s failure. He further said global concern over Wangchuk’s protest was harming India’s democratic image under the BJP government. Nagina MP Chandrashekhar also reached Jantar Mantar Chandrashekhar also reached Jantar Mantar Bhim Army leader and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad also met Sonam Wangchuk at Jantar Mantar on July 15. He accused the government of dictatorship. Chandrashekhar said, “Sonam Wangchuk and many students have been on hunger strike for 10 days. It is painful for me too. I have limited time, otherwise I would have sat here with them.” He claimed that if he joined the protest even for a day, lakhs of people would gather there. He said the government should test people only to the extent that it is justified. CJP demands resignation of Education Minister The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) has been staging a protest at Jantar Mantar since 20 June against the alleged NEET paper leak. The group is demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Activist Sonam Wangchuk has also joined the protest. CJP was formed after Chief Justice Surya Kant's remarks comparing unemployed youth to "cockroaches", a comment that sparked widespread criticism. The party alleged that the government has responded with silence to Wangchuk's efforts to raise issues affecting students. CJP founder Abhijeet Deepke said the government was avoiding accountability and described its approach as cruel. Wangchuk earlier spent 170 days in Jodhpur Jail Wangchuk had earlier spent 170 days in Jodhpur Central Jail while campaigning for full statehood for Ladakh. He was accused of inciting violence during a hunger strike in Leh on 24 September 2025, in which four people were killed and around 90 were injured. The government alleged that Wangchuk had provoked the violence. Two days later, on 26 September, he was detained under the National Security Act (NSA) and sent to Jodhpur Jail.

stories.title: Police leave Jauhar University after Azam's wife's intervention:'We have 15 days. Why are you sitting inside?'
stories.summary: Thirty-eight out of 40 buildings of Jauhar University, owned by former Uttar Pradesh minister and senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, have been declared illegal. The Rampur district administration has ordered demolition of these structures. After the order, Azam Khan’s wife Dr Tazeen Fatima reached Jauhar University on Thursday. She expressed anger after seeing police personnel deployed inside the university campus. She said, “We have a clear court order that gives us 15 days’ time. In such a situation, police and administration cannot forcibly sit inside the university like this. The entire action is being carried out with a sense of hostility.” Tazeen Fatima got the police personnel deployed on duty removed from the university premises. She then went to her office inside the campus, where she met the management and Samajwadi Party leaders. Discussions were held on the strategy to be adopted against the action by the Rampur Development Authority (RDA). Advice was also sought on challenging the District Magistrate’s order in court. SP leaders allege administration acted illegally After the meeting, city president Aseem Raja alleged that the order had given the university 15 days’ time, but it was not followed. “Forget 15 days, not even 15 minutes were given. Immediately after the order, police were deployed inside the university campus and a camp was set up. This is completely illegal,” he said. Administration gave decision within 10 minutes, claims SP leader SP leader Aseem Raja said the university management had submitted its reply to the notice issued on July 15 within the given time. “After this, the district administration called us to present our side verbally, and we appeared there. But the entire action was already decided. Our views were heard, but the decision was announced within just 10 minutes. A press release was issued immediately after that. This shows that the decision was pre-planned,” he said. He alleged that the action was being taken as part of a conspiracy to fulfil the wishes of certain officials and defame the university during the admission process. ‘Why harass us when 15 days were given?’ Aseem Raja said the order clearly provided the university 15 days to present its side, but the administration did not wait even for 15 minutes. “Immediately after issuing the order, police were deployed inside the campus and a counselling camp was set up. This is completely illegal and should be removed immediately,” he said. He added that the university had the right and time to approach the High Court. “The administration should respect the court and the time limit mentioned in its own order,” he said. Claim that all university buildings are legal Aseem Raja claimed that all buildings of Jauhar University are legal and approved maps are available. “If the district administration does not accept these documents, they will be presented before the High Court. The District Magistrate’s decision is not final. We will strongly present our case in court,” he said. He also said that the matter related to the university’s main gate is already pending before the court and a stay order is in place. “In such a situation, taking any action regarding the gate or the public road connected to it is not appropriate,” he added. Administration declares 38 buildings illegal District Magistrate Ajay Kumar Dwivedi had rejected the objections raised by the university management on Wednesday (July 15). Following this, the Rampur Development Authority started the process of action. According to the RDA investigation, only two out of the 40 buildings inside the university campus had approved maps. The remaining 38 buildings were constructed without approval. The District Magistrate said that as per rules, the university management was given 15 days to remove the illegal constructions themselves. If no action is taken within the given period, the RDA will demolish the illegal structures.

stories.title: Sub-inspector refuses to return bribe money despite DIG's orders:Gonda SHO reprimanded; 'Your officer is bringing disrepute to the force'
stories.summary: “Your station's inspector took ₹30,000 in the name of filing a chargesheet. Later, he filed a final report in the case. What are you doing there? It's the SHO's job to ensure there's no corruption in the station. Now get his money returned, otherwise I'll suspend you. These people have increased corruption. They are all tarnishing the department's name. They have brought shame to the entire zone and the entire district.” These words were spoken by Devipatan Range DIG Ashok Kumar Shukla to the Tarbganj SHO over the phone in Gonda. The matter came up when the DIG was conducting a public hearing. Just then, a person arrived. He said that Inspector Om Prakash Yadav had taken ₹30,000 to file a chargesheet, but later filed a final report instead. After hearing the complaint, the DIG called the SHO and reprimanded him. He asked for the money to be returned immediately. The incident is from 9 July, but its video surfaced today. However, the victim claims that despite the DIG's reprimand, the money has not been returned yet. Read the entire case in detail King Upadhyay, a resident of Mannipura village in Tarbganj police station area, reached the DIG office on 9 July. There, DIG Ashok Kumar Shukla was listening to people's problems. King complained that Inspector Om Prakash Yadav, posted at Tarbganj police station, had taken ₹30,000 from him to file a chargesheet in an assault case, but later filed a final report. He said, "I have been telling the inspector for a month that if you haven't done my work, then return my money but he is neither answering calls nor replying to my messages." He also showed the DIG screenshots of messages sent to the inspector. Seeing this, the DIG became furious. Upon hearing the complaint, DIG Ashok Kumar Shukla immediately called the Tarbganj SO. He said, “SO Tarbganj, you have an inspector there named Om Prakash Yadav. I am sending you a photo of this case number. The inspector had taken ₹30,000 to file a chargesheet, but instead filed a final report on it.” “If there is basis for a chargesheet, then file the chargesheet. Get his ₹30,000 returned immediately, otherwise I will get it returned. You will do the work of sending him to jail. When the inspector took ₹30,000 from the person, what were you doing there? I have seen his WhatsApp chat,” the DIG said. “They are messaging the inspector to return my money. If he had the courage, he would have asked which money, what money are you talking about. He is sitting quietly because he must have taken the money. If there is such corruption, you will be suspended,” he said. My vehicle was vandalised Victim King Upadhyay said, “On January 23, 2026, Raja from the same village vandalised my car and broke the glass. When I protested, he assaulted me. I filed a case and pleaded with Inspector Om Prakash Yadav to file a chargesheet.” “The inspector demanded ₹30,000 from me for this. I gave the money in February. Later, the inspector filed the final report. We messaged him on WhatsApp to return the money. He said he had come on duty to Bahraich and would return it. I have been wandering around for two months, but he was not giving the money. Then I met the DIG,” King said.

stories.title: Maulana claims Lord Krishna offered namaz five times:Protests erupt in Lucknow; Ayodhya saint announces ₹10 lakh reward for cutting his tongue
stories.summary: A cleric from Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, Maulana Jarjis Ansari, has sparked a controversy with his remarks on Lord Krishna. The cleric claimed that Lord Krishna was a Muslim and used to offer namaz five times a day. He further said that if Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, whom he described as a devotee of Lord Ram, reads Islamic scriptures, he would start loving Islam. After a video of the Maulana’s remarks surfaced on social media on Thursday, Hindu organisations expressed strong objection. In Lucknow, the Hindu Mahasabha held a protest by trampling on pictures of Maulana Jarjis Ansari and submitted a complaint seeking an FIR at Hazratganj police station. Ayodhya saint Vishnu Das condemned the statement and announced a cash reward of ₹10 lakh for anyone who cuts off Maulana Jarjis Ansari’s tongue. The statement is reportedly from June 23, when Maulana Jarjis Ansari delivered a speech at a religious gathering held at Lakrbandha ground in Deoghar district of Jharkhand. Now know the complete matter in detail What did Maulana Jarjis Ansari say? Maulana Jarjis Ansari said, “If our brothers do not mind, even Krishna Ji used to offer namaz five times a day. If you do not believe it, look at the 10th verse of the sixth chapter of the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita.” He quoted the Sanskrit verse: “Yogi yunjit satatam aatmanam rahasi sthitah Ekaki yatachittatma niraashir aparigrahah.” The Maulana claimed that in this verse Lord Krishna was telling Arjuna that while worshipping God, a person should involve his entire body in yoga. He said, “Yogi does not mean the Yogi from Uttar Pradesh. ‘Yogi yunjit satatam aatmanam’ means one should connect the entire body. Worship should not be done only by standing and raising hands. The entire body should be involved.” He further claimed that if Hindus and Muslims read their own scriptures, they would start loving Islam. He said, “Yogi Ji is a great devotee of Ram. If he reads his own books, then believe me, he will start loving Islam because Islam is not only the religion of Muslims, it is also their religion. This same faith was presented by Ramchandra Ji and Krishna Ji as well.” by Ramchandra ji also, by Krishna ji also. This is not just for Muslims.' Experts say Maulana misinterpreted Gita verse Maulana Jarjis Ansari’s interpretation of the Bhagavad Gita verse has been questioned. The verse does not mention namaz or Islam anywhere. The verse is from Chapter 6, Verse 10 of the Bhagavad Gita. Its actual meaning is that a yogi should continuously focus his mind, body and soul on the Supreme God. A person should meditate in solitude, control the mind and senses, and free himself from desires and attachments. Hindu Mahasabha protests in Lucknow Members of the Hindu Mahasabha, led by spokesperson Shishir Chaturvedi, protested against Maulana Jarjis Ansari in Lucknow. They reached Hazratganj police station and submitted a complaint against him. Shishir said, “Maulana Jarjis called Lord Krishna a strict Muslim who offered namaz five times a day. This is a grave insult to Sanatan Dharma. We have come to get an FIR registered.” He added that if action was not taken, they would march towards the Chief Minister’s residence and later towards Akhilesh Yadav’s residence. He said, “Akhilesh Yadav spoke a lot about the Ram Temple donation theft case. At least say a few words for your ancestor Lord Krishna and register an FIR. You are from Etawah and Maulana Jarjis is also from Etawah.” Political reactions over the statement VHP says action should be taken Vishwa Hindu Parishad national spokesperson Vinod Bansal said such statements were not new. He said, “Earlier too, statements were made about Lord Shiva by Arshad Madani. People like Maulana Jarjis have crossed limits several times, but they do not feel ashamed. If someone speaks about them, groups immediately react, but making such comments about our deities is unacceptable. Action should be taken.” Congress calls it an attempt to create tension before elections Congress spokesperson Surendra Rajput said people should not pay attention to such statements. He said, “As elections approach, BJP supporters, whether they are extreme religious figures or such hardline clerics, will try to poison the atmosphere by making such statements. Strict action should be taken against such people.” Ayodhya saint says Maulana made remarks for publicity Ayodhya saint Dharmdas Maharaj said the Maulana made such remarks only to gain attention. He said, “The Maulana does not have knowledge and said too much in an attempt to get publicity. These events belong to thousands of years ago. Their history is only 1,300-1,400 years old. Before that, there was only Sanatan Dharma.” Ayodhya saint announces ₹10 lakh reward Ayodhya saint Vishnu Das said, “A Maulana has claimed that Lord Krishna was Muslim and offered namaz. Whoever cuts his tongue will be given a reward of ₹10 lakh.” He alleged that the statement hurt the sentiments of crores of Krishna devotees. He said, “He does not know even a single word of Sanskrit and is wrongly interpreting verses of the Bhagavad Gita. A case of sedition should be registered against him.” He also questioned Akhilesh Yadav, saying, “He calls himself a Yadav, but has not spoken a single word against this statement. Why does he remain silent against such Maulanas?”

stories.title: Two SP councillors face off in Gorakhpur:One withdraws nomination, six elected unopposed to new Municipal Corporation executive
stories.summary: In the Gorakhpur Municipal Corporation Board meeting, the names of six new executive members have been announced. As many as seven councillors had filed nominations for this. Among them, two SP councillors – Chandrabhan Prajapati from Ward No. 23 and Noor Mohammad from Ward No. 74 -- were contesting against each other. However, later, after persuasion by senior party leaders, Noor Mohammad withdrew his nomination. The remaining six people were elected unopposed. This election process took place on Thursday afternoon around 2:30 PM. These councillors were selected The executive members who have been selected include Anand Sahni (BJP) from Ward No. 54, Aarti Singh (BJP) from Ward No. 66, Rajesh Kumar (BJP) from Ward No. 22, Rajendra Tiwari (BJP) from Ward No. 36, Ritesh Singh (BJP) from Ward No. 17, and Councillor Chandrabhan Prajapati (SP) from Ward 23 Shaheed Shiv Singh Kshetri Nagar. After the formation of the Municipal Corporation's executive committee, the Deputy Chairman will be elected from among the members included in it. Six members of the old executive will be out Due to completion of tenure, six members of the current executive will leave their posts. These include BJP's Vice President Pawan Tripathi, Rishi Mohan Verma, Chhote Lal Yadav, Shravan Patel and Saroj Paswan. Apart from this, the tenure of Samajwadi Party councillor Ramesh Yadav is also ending. With the end of Vice President Pawan Tripathi's tenure, the election of a new Vice President will also be held from among the new members of the executive. All eyes are on this meeting of the Municipal Corporation, with the formation of the new executive, a new team will emerge that will determine the direction of important decisions and development works of the Municipal Corporation.

stories.title: VIDEO | Doctor dies by suicide after being slapped:Body recovered from Yamuna, parents inconsolable, hospital operator arrested
stories.summary: The body of the doctor who jumped into the Yamuna River in Auraiya was recovered on Thursday morning at 11 am after 18 hours. The SDRF team conducted a search operation and retrieved the body from the river. Upon seeing the body, the parents and wife broke down in tears. The father sat down on the riverbank, unconscious from crying. Before jumping into the river, the doctor had posted a video on Instagram accusing the brother-in-law of a hospital operator of slapping and assaulting him. The incident is from the city Kotwali area. The doctor had jumped into the river from the Yamuna bridge on Wednesday evening around 5 pm. In this case, the police have arrested the hospital operator. See pictures... Know the complete case Lakhimpur Kheri resident Dr. Saurabh Vajpayee was a BMS doctor. He practised at Ram Autar Hospital located in Tilak Nagar of Auraiya city. His family includes father Nandkishore, mother Shikha, brother Sharad, wife Ruby and a five-year-old son Hridyansh. On Wednesday evening around 5 pm, Saurabh reached Yamuna bridge. There he posted two videos on Instagram and then jumped into the river. In the first video, he alleged that Sarvesh Singh, brother-in-law of the owner of Ram Autar Hospital, slapped him. In the second video, he appealed to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for justice. Read what the doctor said in the video? Dr. Saurabh said, "I work at Ramautar Hospital. Dr. SP Singh's brother-in-law Sarvesh Singh raised his hand on me. I had been asking to change my room for three months. When I didn't get a room, I started shifting my belongings myself. During this, he abused me, slapped me and choked my neck." He said that he reached Auraiya Kotwali, but an attempt was made to settle the matter there. His allegation was, "The SHO was also engaged in mediating a settlement." He said, "If I commit suicide, then Sarvesh Singh, his son and Gaurav Singh will be responsible for it. I still consider SP Singh as my elder brother, but these people will be responsible for my death." Body found on Thursday morning Till late Wednesday evening, police and divers conducted a search operation in the Yamuna river, but the doctor could not be traced. On Thursday morning, SDRF started the operation again. After about two hours, the doctor's body was recovered approximately 200 meters away from the spot where he had jumped. Mother Shikha Vajpayee kept saying while crying- My son is gone... my child is gone! Alas, we want action to be taken against Gaurav Singh... Seeing her husband's body, wife Ruby Vajpayee alleged, "My husband was killed by Sarvesh, SP Singh, Gaurav and 20-25 people together. After the incident, he had told me that these people were settling an old grudge because he had called the accused 'driver' instead of 'brother-in-law'. The police are also hand-in-glove with the accused." FIR on complaint of family members After the body was found, the police sent it for post-mortem. SP Abhishek Bharti said that a case has been registered against hospital operator SP Singh and his relative on the complaint of the family members. Hospital operator SP Singh has been arrested. ASP Alok Mishra said that both parties had come to the police station. It has come to light that the hospital operator's brother-in-law slapped him. An attempt was made to reach a settlement between both parties. Further action will be taken based on the investigation of the case.

stories.title: Students gherao BHU Vice-Chancellor's office:Proctorial Board intervenes as protesters question delay in Medical Superintendent taking charge
stories.summary: Students gheraoed the Vice Chancellor's office at Kashi Hindu University, on Thursday afternoon at 3 PM, demanding immediate charge handover to the newly appointed Medical Superintendent of Sir Sunderlal Hospital and Trauma Center In-charge. During this, male and female students raised slogans against the university administration, submitted a memorandum to the Vice Chancellor, and demanded a quick decision. The protest was led by student leaders Shivansh Singh and Harsh Tripathi. The students stated that despite new appointments being made to the concerned posts, the officers have not been formally handed over charge. This is affecting the hospital's administrative system and creating a state of confusion among employees and common people. Students gave a letter to the VC Student leader Shivansh Singh said that Sir Sunderlal Hospital is one of the most important medical institutions in the state. Not handing over charge to officers even after appointment in such an institution reflects serious administrative negligence. He said that if the transfer of responsibilities does not happen on time, unnecessary obstacles may arise in administrative and financial work. He demanded from the university administration that new appointments be given charge with immediate effect so that the hospital's operations can be conducted with complete transparency and accountability. He warned that if the university administration does not take any concrete decision in this matter within two days, students will be compelled to make the movement more widespread and intense. He said that the students' objective is not any kind of confrontation, but to ensure smooth and transparent administration in the university. Names not being announced after appointments Student leader Harsh Tripathi said that the continuation of work by old in-charges even after new appointments raises many questions. He said that the university administration should complete the charge handover process without any delay, so that the proper transfer of administrative powers, records and financial responsibilities can be ensured. According to him, transparent administration strengthens the credibility of the university.

stories.title: VIDEO | Cyclist killed after being run over by truck:CCTV shows him losing balance; another man has a narrow escape
stories.summary: A 45-year-old man died after being crushed under the wheel of a truck fitted with a concrete mixer machine, in Varanasi on Thursday morning. The accident was so horrific that the victim's intestines came out. While the truck was passing, the cyclist suddenly lost balance. He came under the rear wheel of the truck along with the bicycle. However, the second person sitting on the back of the bicycle narrowly escaped the truck. This incident occurred on the Azamgarh Highway in the Cholapur police station area. CCTV footage of the accident has also emerged. The police have seized the footage and started searching for the truck and its driver. See 2 pictures... Know the complete matter Nakhru Rajbhar alias Kallu (45), a resident of Jairampur Saraiya village, had come to his in-laws' village Pahadpur on Wednesday. On Thursday morning, he was going to Danaganj market on a bicycle with his relative for some work. Nakhru was riding the bicycle and his relative was sitting on the carrier. When they reached the highway, suddenly a truck with a concrete mixer passed by them. At that moment, for some reason, the balance of their bicycle got disturbed. Before he could control it, Nakhru along with the bicycle came between the two wheels of the truck. Before anyone could understand anything, the rear wheel of the truck ran over him. After the accident, people from nearby gathered. The police were informed. The police who reached the spot took possession of the body and sent it for post-mortem. Meanwhile, after the accident, the truck driver fled from the spot. Used to support family by running a cart Nakhru Rajbhar used to support his family by running a cart. His family includes wife Pummi Devi, three sons and one daughter. All four children study in the village school. As soon as the news of the accident was received, there was chaos in the family. Police says search is on for the driver and the truck Station in-charge Sadhuwan Ram Gautam said: An elderly person has died in a road accident. After the accident, the accused vehicle fled from the spot. The accused vehicle is being searched for on the basis of CCTV footage. Action is being taken on the basis of the complaint received from the family members.

stories.title: Seven-year-old killed by school bus in Mathura:Grieving father holds child's body as protesters vandalise school, clash with police
stories.summary: A seven-year-old child died after being crushed under the wheel of a school bus in Mathura, on Thursday morning. After reaching school, the child was getting down from the bus when the driver moved the vehicle forward. The child fell and came under the wheel. He died on the spot. Upon receiving the information, the family members reached the accident site. The father started weeping, holding his son's body in his lap. Seeing the blood-soaked body of the child, the anger of the family members and villagers erupted. The enraged people vandalised the school premises and created a huge ruckus. After this, they took the child's body to Govardhan Road and blocked the road. The protesters insisted on the arrest of the accused driver. The police who arrived at the scene tried to pacify them, but they did not agree. After this, when the police tried to remove them, there was a scuffle between the villagers and the police. Currently, the family members are sitting on the road and the police are trying to calm them down. A large number of police personnel are deployed at the scene. The incident occurred in the Jainth police station area. See pictures Know the full story Nitin, the 7-year-old son of Gangdev, a resident of Pelkhu village, studied in Class-2 at Tilak Singh Inter College in Ral village. As usual, he reached school by bus around 8:30 AM on Thursday morning. According to eyewitnesses, the bus driver was intoxicated. When the bus reached the school campus, children started getting off. Nitin was still getting off when the driver moved the bus forward. The innocent child stumbled, fell down, and came under the bus's rear wheel. People nearby and children screamed, but by then, he was severely crushed by the wheel. The child died on the spot after being run over by the bus wheel. Family members vandalised the school Upon receiving information about the incident, family members and villagers reached the school. Seeing the child's body, people's anger erupted. The father, holding his blood-soaked son's body in his lap, started weeping. Meanwhile, angry people started creating a ruckus. People started looking for the driver. But he had fled from the scene. When the driver was not found, angry people vandalised the main gate of the school and the glass panes inside. The commotion continued in the school premises for a long time. Body placed on Govardhan Road, blocking it After this, the family members took Nitin's body to Govardhan Road. They placed the body and blocked the road. Upon receiving information about the jam, the police arrived. Officials tried to persuade the family members to clear the jam, but they remained firm on their demands. After this, the police tried to remove them. During this, there was some pushing and shoving between some villagers and policemen. The police tried to forcibly remove the people, but seeing the anger of the people, the police had to retreat. Currently, the family members are sitting on the road. They say that they will not move from there until action is taken against the accused driver. The police are continuously trying to persuade them.

stories.title: Raja Bhaiya wins bronze in shooting championship:Strongman-politician has arsenal of over 200 firearms
stories.summary: Strongman MLA Raghuraj Pratap Singh, alias Raja Bhaiya, has won the bronze medal in the 49th UP State Shooting Championship. He scored 25 points in S-25 Clay Pigeon Trap Shooting (NR). The championship was held from 21 June to 30 June at Dr. Karni Singh Shooting Range in New Delhi. Raja Bhaiya participated as competitor number 71. Results were declared on Wednesday. A video of his shooting has surfaced. In it, Raja Bhaiya can be seen taking aim. Raja Bhaiya is fond of weapons. Last year, on the occasion of Dussehra, he showcased his collection of more than 200 weapons. Raja Bhaiya is a seven-time MLA from Kunda constituency in Pratapgarh. He has formed his own party, Jansatta Dal, of which he is the national president. Raja Bhaiya is a lifetime member of the rifle association Raja Bhaiya is a lifetime member of the National Rifle Association of India (NRAI). He had mentioned in an interview that his father, Uday Pratap Singh, was also a shooter. Every year on the occasion of Dussehra, Raja Bhaiya worships the weapons kept in his arsenal. Last year, a video of his weapon worship on Dussehra also surfaced. In it, more than 200 domestic and foreign weapons were seen adorned on the table. These included pistols, revolvers, 12 bore guns, rifles and thirty carbines. During the weapon worship, Raja Bhaiya had said, “All these weapons are ours. What is ours, belongs to the supporters, and what belongs to the supporters, is ours.” Divorce case ongoing with wife Bhanvi Singh Raja Bhaiya's divorce case with his wife Bhanvi is ongoing. Bhanvi has been living separately from her husband in Delhi for several years. In November 2022, she filed a divorce petition in Delhi's Saket Court. Bhanvi had accused Raja Bhaiya of assault and illicit relations. On June 3, 2025, wife Bhanvi wrote a letter to the PMO alleging that Raja Bhaiya possesses a cache of illegal foreign weapons. Following this, on September 18, 2025, Bhanvi released a video of the weapons on social media. She claimed that there are some weapons in it that could cause mass destruction.

stories.title: Ramgarh Tal to get passenger boat service:GDA to spend ₹3 crore, fare set at ₹40 to ₹50
stories.summary: Work is underway to enhance facilities at Ramgarh Tal in Gorakhpur. After constructing floating cum pillar jetties around the lake, there is now consensus on operating passenger boats. Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA) has received permission from the Transport Ministry to purchase boats and operate them. The authority is planning to make this purchase. Approximately ₹3 crore will be spent on this. There is a plan to select an experienced firm for operation. The fare is estimated to be around ₹40 to ₹50. Through this boat, people can tour various areas of Ramgarh Tal. The floating jetties will serve as its platforms. If someone from RKBK wants to come to Naya Savera, they can park their vehicle in the parking there and come here by boat. After visiting, they can return by the same boat. Know the features of the boat- GDA is also going to build a floating jetty GDA Vice President said - Tourists will have facilities GDA Vice President Abhinav Gopal said, “There is a plan to purchase passenger boats for the convenience of tourists. It will be operated in Ramgarh Tal. Sitting on this, people will be able to go from one end of the lake to the other end. For this, some floating cum pillar jetties will also be built. A nominal fare will have to be paid for travelling on this.”

stories.title: Constable dies by suicide after leave is denied:Claims in final audio he is ending his life because of three police personnel
stories.summary: A 25-year-old police constable died by suicide with his service rifle at around 3 am on Thursday in Bulandshahr. A fellow constable tried to stop him, but the disturbed man fired a shot into the air. The colleague then ran to inform the outpost in charge. Before anyone could intervene, the constable shot himself. Police reached the spot and found him dead. City SP Abhishek Pratap identified the constable as Sudhir. Before his death, Sudhir recorded an audio message alleging that his station house officer (SHO) and two station clerks (munshis) were responsible for his death. He claimed that after complaining of stomach pain, the SHO had harassed him and sent him to the police lines. He also alleged that the two munshis ignored his requests. Sudhir's sister-in-law also alleged that he took his own life after being denied leave. Earlier, however, a fellow constable had said Sudhir had been under emotional stress because the woman he loved had married someone else a month ago. According to the colleague, Sudhir repeatedly said, "I want to die." Following the incident, SP Dinesh Kumar Singh attached SHO Rahul Chaudhary and the two munshis, Ankit and Sudhir, to the police lines pending an inquiry. A departmental investigation has been ordered against all three. The incident took place in the Lakhawati police outpost area of Aurangabad. Sudhir Thakur was a resident of Sangecha village in Iradatnagar, Agra. He had joined the police force only three months ago. After receiving news of his death, his father Jagveer reached the mortuary and broke down on seeing his son's body. Circle Officer Prakhar Pandey tried to console him. Colleague: 'He kept saying he no longer wanted to live' Sudhir was the second of three brothers. His elder brother Krishna (32) is a farmer, while his younger brother Pawan (21) is a student. His parents, Jagveer and Guddi Devi, support the family through farming. According to fellow constable Saurabh, Sudhir appeared restless despite sitting with colleagues late on Wednesday night. He repeatedly said he no longer wanted to live. At around 3 am on Thursday, Sudhir picked up his service rifle and began walking towards a canal a short distance from the Lakhawati outpost. Saurabh said he became suspicious and followed him. Sudhir asked him not to come any closer, but Saurabh refused. The two argued, during which Sudhir said he intended to end his life. When Saurabh tried to stop him, Sudhir fired a shot into the air. Saurabh then ran to alert the outpost in charge. Moments later, Sudhir placed the rifle against his neck and fired, collapsing onto the road. What Sudhir said in his audio message In the recording, Sudhir said that on 13 July, he developed severe stomach pain and informed munshis Ankit and Sudhir, but they ignored him. He said he later approached SHO Rahul Chaudhary, who became angry, mistreated him, verbally abused him and had him attached to the police lines. He said he had become so distressed by the treatment that he was resigning from both his job and his life. He alleged that the SHO and the two munshis were responsible for his suicide and ended the message by saying that he only wanted justice. Sister-in-law: 'He was harassed after asking for leave' Sudhir's sister-in-law Chinki said he had called his elder brother to say he was suffering from stomach pain. His brother advised him to apply for leave, but Sudhir said his request had been refused and that he had instead been harassed. She said the family received a call from a police officer at around 5 am informing them that Sudhir had died by suicide, after which they left for Bulandshahr. Sudhir had visited home about 15–20 days ago and had previously returned to appear for the Sub-Inspector recruitment examination.

stories.title: Rain lashes 10 UP cities, alert for 36 districts:Dashashwamedh Ghat steps submerged; Ghaghara swells in Ballia as residents demolish homes
stories.summary: Monsoon has regained momentum across Uttar Pradesh, with showers reported since Thursday morning in 10 cities, including Lucknow, Barabanki and Jaunpur. Several roads in Lucknow have been waterlogged following the downpour. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for seven districts, including Lucknow. According to the department, heavy rain is likely over the next three hours in Amethi, Barabanki, Hardoi, Lucknow, Rae Bareli, Sitapur and Unnao. Winds of 40–50 kmph and lightning are also expected during this period. Cloud cover persists over most parts of the state, and the IMD has issued a rain alert for 36 districts today. Rising water levels in rivers, fuelled by rainfall in the hills, have begun affecting parts of Uttar Pradesh. In Ballia, erosion has started along the banks of the Saryu and Ghaghara rivers. In Bansdih, residents are demolishing their permanent homes and relocating, with around 150 families having left so far. In Varanasi, rising water levels in the Ganga have submerged the first three steps of Dashashwamedh Ghat. However, the river is still 11.90 metres below the danger mark. In Mathura, the Yamuna is in spate, flowing 1.30 metres below the warning level, while the steps of Keshi Ghat in Vrindavan have gone underwater. In Prayagraj, the Ganga and Yamuna have reached the row of shops along the ghats. On Tuesday, rain was recorded in 40 cities across the state. Despite the recent showers, Uttar Pradesh has received 25 per cent less rainfall than normal since 1 June. Rain-bearing clouds disappear from 80% of the state According to the IMD, dry winds blowing in from Pakistan have pushed rain-bearing clouds away from nearly 80 per cent of Uttar Pradesh. As a result, more than half the state has seen little or no rainfall.

stories.title: Eight fire tenders tackle massive Lucknow fire:Dairy, furniture, grocery, welding and AC repair shops destroyed
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out in shops built along the roadside on IIM Road, in Muktakipur, Madiyanv area of Lucknow, early on Thursday morning. The fire engulfed several shops within a short time. Upon receiving information at 1 AM, fire department teams reached the spot. With the help of about eight fire tenders, the fire was completely brought under control after about two and a half hours of effort. Shops, including New Bharat Milk Dairy, a furniture shop, a tea shop, Nadeem General Store, a welding shop, a grocery store, an AC repair shop, and others, were gutted in the fire. Two fire tenders arrived, later six more were called According to the fire department, the fire incident was reported to the Bakhshi Ka Talab fire station. Under the direction of the Chief Fire Officer, two fire tenders were immediately dispatched to the scene, led by the In-charge Fire Officer. Upon arrival, the fire had taken a fierce form and was spreading rapidly. Considering the seriousness of the situation, additional fire tenders, including one from Indiranagar, two from Chowk, a water bowser and a Multi-Disaster Response Vehicle from Hazratganj, were called to the scene. All teams surrounded the area and continuously sprayed water, after which the fire was brought under control.

stories.title: Deputy CM visits Varanasi:Prays at Baba Vishwanath and Bankati Hanuman temples; says people must have faith in Ayodhya investigation
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya arrived in Varanasi on Thursday. He first visited Shri Kashi Vishwanath Dham and performed darshan of Baba Vishwanath. Varanasi Cantt Assembly constituency MLA Saurabh Srivastava accompanied Maurya during the darshan. The Deputy Chief Minister remained in the temple premises for about half an hour and gathered information from officials about the facilities and security arrangements for devotees in view of the month of Sawan. After darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, the Deputy Chief Minister went to Bankati Hanuman Temple located at Durgakund. Here he had darshan of Pawan Putra Hanuman and prayed for the happiness, prosperity and welfare of the people of the state. Expressed gratitude for the budget announced by PM Welcoming the development projects worth approximately ₹25,000 crore announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi for Kashi and Purvanchal, the Deputy CM said that this will prove to be a milestone in the development of Kashi and several surrounding districts. Maurya said that he has seen Kashi during the governments of Congress, Samajwadi Party and Bahujan Samaj Party, and is also seeing today's Kashi, where a wonderful coordination of development, modern facilities and religious faith is visible. Maurya said that today whoever comes to Kashi, truly experiences it as the city of Baba Vishwanath. Deputy CM speaks on Ayodhya offering theft case In response to a question asked about the theft of offerings in Ayodhya, Keshav Prasad Maurya said that this is a sad incident of theft. He said that the police are arresting the accused and investigating the entire matter. Along with this, the SIT is also engaged in the investigation and the truth will come out soon. He said that all people should have faith in the law. Along with this, giving a religious reference, he said that one should also have faith in the mace of Hanuman Ji Maharaj. Takes aim at Akhilesh Yadav On a question asked about a viral poster of Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav, the Deputy Chief Minister launched a sharp attack. He said that Akhilesh Yadav comes from that family whose head was Mulayam Singh Yadav, during whose rule bullets were fired at unarmed Ram devotees in Ayodhya. He alleged that Akhilesh Yadav has never shown respect towards Ram, Shiva and Krishna and has ignored the sentiments of Hindu society. Maurya said that whenever Akhilesh Yadav makes such statements or posts, it hurts the sentiments of Ram devotees, patriots and the saint community.

stories.title: Son shoots father with six bullets:Murder linked to ₹150 crore property dispute; mother says, 'You have destroyed our family'
stories.summary: A son murdered his father over a property dispute worth ₹150 crore in Ghaziabad. According to the police, around 12 AM on Wednesday night, the accused shot his father 6 times in the face, chest, and stomach with a pistol. According to family members, the son had come home after drinking alcohol. The father scolded him, after which he committed the crime. Seeing her husband's dead body, the wife screamed and told her son, “You have ruined the entire house.” After the incident, the accused fled. Family members took Hariom Chaudhary to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Police investigation revealed that the son, Nikhil Nehra (32), was pressuring his father to transfer the property into his name. His father, Hariom Chaudhary (52), was not ready for this. He feared that his son would sell the land and squander the money on alcohol. According to the police, about eight years ago, Nikhil had also shot his younger brother Nishu, but he survived. Police have deployed 4 teams to search for the accused. The incident occurred in the Modinagar police station area. 25 bigha land was in son's name Hariom Chaudhary was a resident of Budana village in the Modinagar police station area of Ghaziabad. He was a prosperous farmer. In his name, there is 75 bigha land near Modinagar and a market in front of Jeevan Hospital on the Delhi-Meerut Road. His total assets are estimated to be around ₹150 crore. His family includes wife Anita, elder son Nikhil Nehra, and younger son Nishu. Both sons are unmarried. ACP Bhaskar Verma said that the elder son Nikhil is addicted to alcohol. Because of this, he often had disputes with his father. His father did not like his drinking and used to scold him. He had also given Nikhil shops in the market and 25 bighas of land, but he wanted to transfer the remaining property to his name as well. The ACP stated that on Wednesday night, Hariom Chaudhary had dinner with his wife and younger son. At that time, the elder son Nikhil was not at home. He arrived home late at night after drinking alcohol. According to family members, the father scolded him for coming home drunk. At this, Nikhil pulled out an illegal pistol and started abusing his father. An argument ensued between the two. Hearing the noise, Hariom's wife Anita and younger son Nishu also reached there. During this, a scuffle broke out and Nikhil fired shots at his father. As soon as he was shot, Hariom fell to the floor. Hearing the sound of gunfire, nearby people arrived and took him to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. ACP says, ‘Accused will be caught soon’ Modinagar ACP Bhaskar Verma stated that the elder son murdered his father. Family members have mentioned a land dispute. Police are investigating all aspects. A case has been registered against the accused based on the family's complaint. He will be arrested soon.

stories.title: Lucknow sees stormy rain with 50 kmph winds:2-storey house collapses in Noida, funeral held under tarpaulin in Jhansi
stories.summary: The monsoon has once again picked up pace in Uttar Pradesh. Heavy rainfall has been lashing Lucknow since 6 pm on Thursday evening. Strong winds blowing at nearly 50 kmph were also recorded. Several roads across the city were waterlogged. The state capital had also witnessed heavy rainfall in the morning. Rainfall was recorded in more than 15 cities including Barabanki and Jaunpur on Thursday. In Jhansi’s Tahrauli area, people were seen performing a funeral under a tarpaulin amid rain. In Greater Noida’s Tilpata village, a two-storey house suddenly collapsed around 1:30 pm on Thursday afternoon. The house was located near a drain, and its foundation had weakened due to rainfall. Fortunately, no casualties were reported. The Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert for 36 districts on Thursday. Rainfall is expected across the entire state on Friday. During this period, thunderstorms and strong winds are also likely. Meanwhile, rising rainfall in hilly regions has started increasing the water levels of rivers in Uttar Pradesh. In Ballia, erosion has begun along the banks of the Ghaghra River. In Bansdih, people are demolishing their own concrete houses and shifting to safer locations. So far, 150 families have left their homes. In Varanasi, three steps of Dashashwamedh Ghat have submerged due to the rising water level of the Ganga. However, the river is still flowing 11.90 metres below the danger mark. In Mathura, the Yamuna River is in spate, with the water level flowing 1.30 metres below the warning level. The steps of Vrindavan’s Keshi Ghat have also been submerged. In Prayagraj, the water of the Ganga and Yamuna rivers has reached shops built along the ghats. Earlier on Tuesday, rainfall was recorded in 40 cities across the state. Meanwhile, since June 1, Uttar Pradesh has received 25% less rainfall than normal. Monsoon likely to intensify from July 17 Rainfall was recorded in 25 cities during the last 24 hours. The highest rainfall of 22.5 mm was recorded in Lakhimpur Kheri. Uttar Pradesh has received 27% less rainfall than required so far. The Meteorological Department said heavy rainfall activity is likely to increase in eastern UP from July 17 and in western UP from the following day. Lucknow senior meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said: “A weather system has formed over eastern UP. The monsoon line is passing through the Terai region. Due to this, clouds are present, but most parts of the state are not receiving good rainfall. A low-pressure area formed over the Bay of Bengal is continuously strengthening. It is likely to move towards the northwest in the next 48 hours. Due to its impact, the monsoon will become active again in UP after July 17 and good rainfall is expected.” Funeral performed under tarpaulin amid rain in Jhansi A distressing picture has emerged from Bangri Bangra village in Tahrauli tehsil of Jhansi district, where a lack of basic facilities forced villagers to perform a funeral under a tarpaulin during heavy rainfall. Due to the absence of a tin shed at the cremation ground, the family of a poor man had to conduct his last rites while taking shelter under a tarpaulin. The deceased had reportedly suffered from illness and financial difficulties throughout his life. Even after his death, he could not receive a dignified farewell. During the funeral, family members and villagers had to rely on a tarpaulin to protect themselves from rain. After the video of the incident surfaced, villagers expressed anger against the local administration and public representatives. They said even basic facilities like a tin shed had not been provided at the cremation ground, making an already sensitive process difficult. Villagers have demanded that necessary facilities be provided soon. Latest rain update from Lucknow After dark clouds covered the city, heavy rainfall started in Lucknow. Before the rain, cold winds were blowing at a speed of nearly 50 kmph. People in Gomti Nagar, Para and Kakori areas were seen taking shelter under underpasses to avoid getting drenched. Office-goers waited for the water level to recede before continuing their journey. Kanpur receives heavy evening rain, heat and humidity reduce People in Kanpur suffered due to intense heat and humidity since Thursday morning. Around 5:15 pm, the weather suddenly changed as dark clouds covered the sky and heavy rain started. The rainfall brought relief from the heat and humidity. Before the rain, the maximum temperature recorded in the afternoon was 36.6°C. According to the Meteorological Department, temperatures are expected to fall further after the rain, keeping the weather pleasant for the next few hours.

stories.title: Ram Mandir theft row:Accused Anukalp got close to Champat Rai by reciting poetry; villagers shut doors, refuse to talk
stories.summary: Anukalp had a deep interest in reading and reciting poetry. In 2024, he performed at a Kavi Sammelan in Ayodhya, where the chief guest was Champat Rai, General Secretary of the Ram Mandir Trust. According to people familiar with the matter, Champat Rai appreciated his performance and blessed him by placing his hand on Anukalp's head. That meeting proved to be a turning point. Anukalp reportedly began addressing Champat Rai as "Babuji" and, through those connections, secured entry into the Ram Mandir administration. He was eventually assigned duty in the mandir's cash-counting room. According to the Special Investigation Team (SIT), Anukalp gradually siphoned off crores of rupees from the mandir offerings over a period of time. However, investigators found only ₹16.82 lakh in his bank account. Back in his native Basawan village in Milkipur, his grandfather told Dainik Bhaskar, "It was looting in the name of Lord Ram. He started looting and eventually got caught." Today, the family claims Anukalp's name has become synonymous with disgrace in the village. Village turns its back on Anukalp To understand Anukalp's life before joining the Ram Mandir, the Dainik Bhaskar team visited Basawan village, around 40 kilometres from Ayodhya. The village has a population of nearly 2,000. As reporters walked through its narrow lanes towards Anukalp's house, they found villagers unwilling to speak about him. Several residents got up and walked away when questioned, while others shut their doors. Some even advised the team not to visit his house, saying "nothing good" would come of it. The prevailing mood in the village was one of resentment, with many residents unwilling even to hear Anukalp's name. Grandfather says he never believed his grandson could do this At the family home, reporters met Anukalp's grandfather, Rajendra Mishra, who suffers from a heart condition. Speaking about his grandson's arrest, Rajendra said, "No one tells me what is happening. He is only 18 years old. I don't know why his father sent him to work at the Ram Mandir. I had sent him to Prayagraj for his studies. A few months later, I learnt that he had gone to Ayodhya instead." Asked whether investigators had visited the family, he replied, "Whoever needed to come came and questioned us. We had nothing to hide." When asked how Anukalp secured work at the Ram Mandir, Rajendra maintained, “I don't think Anukalp could do something like this.” Family blames internal feud for Bhagwat Katha controversy Rajendra also spoke about a dispute that erupted during a Bhagwat Katha organised by Anukalp in Milkipur in April 2026. According to him, the incident stemmed from a long-running family dispute. He said he has four sons, with Anukalp's father, Ravindra Mishra, being the eldest. The youngest son, Brijendra, has an ongoing dispute with his wife, Neha. Rajendra alleged that Neha arrived at the religious event with her family members, triggering a commotion. He further accused his brother, Surendra Mishra, of orchestrating the episode. "He called our daughter-in-law Neha there. He never misses an opportunity to defame our family," Rajendra claimed. When asked about reports that expensive sarees worth around ₹10,000 each had been purchased from a trader in Kumarganj for distribution during the event, and that the SIT had questioned the trader, Rajendra dismissed the allegations. "It is all false. I suspect Surendra framed Anukalp," he said. Uncle questions sudden rise in family wealth Rajendra's brother, Surendra Mishra, presented a different version of events. He said Anukalp's father had struggled financially for years and had lived at his maternal aunt's house for four to five years. Anukalp also spent part of his childhood studying there before becoming associated with the Ram Mandir Trust. Surendra said he was surprised when the family purchased a house in Ayodhya worth around ₹40 lakh last year. "I could not understand where so much money had come from," he said before ending the conversation. Conversations with several villagers suggested that Anukalp's family had long remained socially isolated. Residents said Anukalp's father, Ravindra Mishra, contested the village head election twice but failed to secure even 100 votes on either occasion. He also lost the Block Development Committee (BDC) election. When asked about Ravindra's occupation, villagers said he was associated with a government hospital and used to earn some income there. However, none could clearly identify his designation or exact role. Friend says fame and wealth changed him Back in Ayodhya, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to one of Anukalp's friends, who described him as an ordinary young man before joining the Ram Mandir. The friend said Anukalp regularly attended Kavi Sammelans wherever he heard they were being held and often described himself as a social worker. According to the friend, after Champat Rai entrusted him with an important responsibility at the mandir in 2024, Anukalp's lifestyle changed dramatically. Within six months, he bought his father a Maruti Suzuki Swift Dzire. The friend said Anukalp, who previously wore kurta-pyjamas costing ₹400-500, began wearing branded outfits priced between ₹10,000 and ₹15,000. Planned ₹2 crore land investment, wanted to buy Scorpio The transformation extended to his property ambitions. As the 84 Kosi Parikrama Marg was being developed near Basawan village, Anukalp reportedly expressed interest in buying around two bighas of land in the area. Several property dealers attended the Bhagwat Katha he organised, but the proposed purchase did not materialise because a suitable contiguous plot was unavailable. According to people familiar with the discussions, Anukalp told the dealers he was prepared to invest around ₹2 crore in land. In 2025, he also helped his brother-in-law, Lavkush Mishra, secure a job at the Ram Mandir. Thereafter, the two allegedly became actively involved in purchasing property. Investigators have also received information suggesting that Anukalp bought land in Ambedkar Nagar in his father's name. Those transactions are currently under investigation. Sources further claimed that Anukalp had been planning to purchase a Mahindra Scorpio before the alleged mandir donation theft came to light.

stories.title: How to withdraw money from PF:Step-by-step guide; balance transfers automatically after job change, self e-KYC possible; 8 key rules changed
stories.summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has introduced a series of reforms aimed at making Provident Fund (PF) withdrawals faster and simpler. Members can now apply for withdrawals online from home, receive funds within a fixed timeline, and have their PF balance transferred automatically when changing jobs. The latest reforms include eight major rule changes, covering emergency withdrawals, pension, e-KYC, nominations, and digital services. 1. Easier advance PF withdrawals EPFO has classified advance PF withdrawals into three categories: 2. Full PF withdrawal rules revised EPFO has divided members' PF balances into two parts: Employees who have completed at least one year of service can now withdraw their entire PF balance during emergencies. Earlier, members had to remain unemployed for at least two months after leaving a job before becoming eligible for full withdrawal. The entire PF balance, including the protected 25%, can still be withdrawn upon retirement after the age of 55, permanent disability, job loss under eligible conditions, or permanent relocation abroad. 3. EPS withdrawal waiting period increased Under the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS), the waiting period for pension fund withdrawal has been extended to 36 months under the new EPS Scheme-2026. Previously, the waiting period was two months. 4. PF claims to be settled within 20 days EPFO has fixed a maximum processing period of 20 days for all online PF claims. If an employer deducts PF contributions from employees' salaries but fails to deposit them with EPFO on time, a 12% penalty will be imposed. The amount will be recovered from the salaries of the responsible officials. 5. Automatic PF transfer after job change Employees will no longer need to submit Form 13 when changing jobs. Under the upgraded system, the employee's Universal Account Number (UAN) will automatically synchronize records between the old and new employer. Once the first Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) is filed by the new employer, the PF balance will automatically transfer to the new account. 6. New process for UAN activation and e-KYC To curb PF fraud, EPFO has overhauled the UAN activation process. Members will no longer be able to activate a UAN directly through the EPFO website. Instead, activation will take place through a new secure interface available only on the UMANG mobile app. Aadhaar-based facial authentication has been made mandatory for activating a UAN. 7. e-Nomination made simpler Earlier, members had to submit Form 2 through their employer or the EPFO office to add nominees. Now, nominees can be added online through the EPFO portal using the e-Nomination facility. Members must also upload a recent passport-sized profile photograph on the portal to complete identity verification. 8. Six-month relief for private PF trusts EPFO has granted a six-month compliance window to private PF trusts that are yet to register under its regulations. Trusts completing registration within this period will receive relief from earlier penalties, interest, and legal proceedings, helping safeguard employees' retirement savings. EPFO 3.0 to further simplify PF services EPFO is also preparing to launch its new EPFO 3.0 digital platform. The upgraded system will enable faster claim settlements, quicker withdrawals, multilingual online services, and an improved user experience. More than 300 million account holders are expected to benefit from the new platform. EPFO said the reforms are aimed at making PF services more accessible while continuing to provide 8.25% annual interest on members' deposits. Members facing technical issues related to UAN activation, e-KYC, or login can contact the EPFO official helpline at 14470.

stories.title: Ram Mandir donation theft- SIT submits report to SC:Hearing to be held tomorrow; Rahul writes to PM Modi, says 'Your silence is unacceptable'
stories.summary: The Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the alleged theft of donations at the Ayodhya Ram Mandir submitted its status report to the Supreme Court on Sunday. According to media reports, the report has been filed in a sealed cover. A three-judge bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant is scheduled to hear the matter on Monday. Four separate petitions related to the alleged donation theft have been filed before the Supreme Court. During the previous hearing on July 13, the court issued a notice to the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust and directed the Uttar Pradesh government to submit the SIT's status report within a week. The Uttar Pradesh government constituted the SIT on June 13 at the request of the temple trust. The team comprises Lucknow Divisional Commissioner Vijay Vishwas Pant, IG Kiran S, and Special Secretary (Finance) Neel Ratan. Meanwhile, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, demanding an independent investigation into the trust's financial affairs. They also called for the trust's accounts to be made public so devotees can know how and where the donations have been spent. They said anyone found responsible during the investigation should be held accountable. The letter, written on Saturday and made public on Sunday, stated: "You announced the formation of the trust in Parliament, but its members were appointed entirely by the government. It is well known that the trust members are associated with the RSS, VHP and their affiliates. The former general secretary was also considered close to you. In such circumstances, your silence is unacceptable. Ensuring accountability is your responsibility. The credibility of both the government and the trust depends on it." Police question main accused and his Nephew Sunday marked the last day of police custody for the main accused, Ramashankar Yadav alias 'Tinnu', and his nephew Manish. On Saturday morning at around 8:30 am, police took both men from the district jail on a 39-hour remand. Officials remained at the SOG office until around 11 pm, and the accused were not taken elsewhere during the remand. Tinnu is said to have been a close associate of former trust general secretary Champat Rai. He was responsible for overseeing the temple's donation boxes, while Manish was involved in counting the donations. Police recovered ₹1 lakh from Tinnu's residence and ₹2 lakh from Manish's house. Earlier, police had also taken six other accused into custody on remand. They have been identified as Avinash Shukla, Lavkush Mishra, Anukalp Mishra, Subhash Srivastava, Ramashankar Mishra and Karunesh.

stories.title: Nirmohi Akhada removes Dinendra Das from Mahant post:May also lose Ram Mandir Trust role; Raja Ramchandracharya Das named successor
stories.summary: Nirmohi Akhada has removed Mahant Dinendra Das from his position at the Ayodhya branch. In his place, Raja Ramchandracharya Das Maharaj will now assume responsibility. Along with this, his membership in the Ram Mandir Trust is also in jeopardy. Dinendra Das is an ex-officio member of the Ram Mandir Trust by virtue of being the Mahant of the Ayodhya branch of Nirmohi Akhada. The decision to remove Mahant Dinendra Das from Nirmohi Akhada was taken in a meeting of the Akhada held on July 5. However, this matter came to light on Sunday. The meeting held on July 5 was chaired by Raja Ramchandracharya Das Maharaj, the President of Nirmohi Akhada. In this, allegations were made against Mahant Dinendra Das, including indiscipline, non-compliance with the rules of the Akhada, and concealing important documents. Following this, the sarpanchs and mahants present in the meeting agreed to the proposal to remove him from the post of Mahant. Dinendra Das said - Panches are in my favor; nothing will happen On the news of removing himself from the post of Mahant, Dinendra Das clarified on Sunday. He said, ''Nirmohi Akhada is a panchayati math. Whatever decision the panches take is valid. There are 19 panches in Maharaj Sadan. Out of 19, 13 are in my favor. The remaining 6 are only into politics. Akhada spokesperson Kartik Chopra was earlier our mukhtar (one who has been given authority). I have dismissed him as mukhtar. Kartik is the one talking about removing me. Kartik was doing politics, but he won't be able to do anything. When the panches are in one's favor, nothing will happen.'' CM Yogi was given darshan of Ram Lalla on June 19 After the case of theft of offerings came to light, CM Yogi had reached Ayodhya on June 19 to have darshan of Ram Lalla. At that time, Dinendra Das had arranged the darshan-worship for Yogi. Before this, whenever Yogi reached Ram Mandir, the responsibility of arranging darshan-worship for him was handled by Champat Rai, Dr. Anil Mishra and Gopal Rao. 5 proposals were passed in the meeting According to information received from sources, a meeting of the Panches of Shri Panch Ramanandi Nirmohi Akhada was held in Delhi on July 5. A total of 5 resolutions were passed in this meeting. One resolution was also to remove Mahant Dinendra Das of the Ayodhya branch from his post. This resolution was proposed by Raja Ramchandracharya Das Maharaj, which was agreed upon by 8 saints. 13 members were invited to the meeting. Of these, 8 members were present, while 4 gave their consent online. However, Mahant Dinendra Das did not participate in the meeting. Questions also raised on Ram Mandir Trust membership Dinendra Das is a member of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust as a representative of Nirmohi Akhada. In such a situation, after the decision to remove him from the post of Mahant, his membership of the Trust is also in danger. It is being reported that Nirmohi Akhada has also filed a new petition in the Supreme Court demanding reconstitution of the Trust. According to the report, Mahant Dinendra Das had said that despite the mention of Nirmohi Akhada in the Supreme Court's decision, he has not been given any important responsibility. He had said that if he gets the responsibility of managing the worship arrangements in Ram Mandir, then he is ready for it. Visits Mandir daily to check arrangements Mahant Dinendra Das had stated that currently the worship and rituals at Ram Mandir are being conducted according to the Ramanandi tradition. He visits the Temple daily to monitor the darshan arrangements. There has been significant improvement in Temple management. The system for counting and depositing offerings has also become more transparent than before. Know who is Mahant Dinendra Das Dinendra Das, who was removed from the post of Mahant of Ayodhya's Nirmohi Akhada, joined the sadhu community at the age of 10. He is also a trustee of the trust that is constructing the Ram Mandir. Nirmohi Akhada was the most important party in the Ram Janmabhoomi legal dispute. That is why he is considered an influential Mahant in Ayodhya. Dinendra Das is the only local resident saint member from Ayodhya in the Ram Mandir Trust. In the year 2019, the Supreme Court delivered a historic verdict in favor of the Ram Mandir. At that time, the court gave special instructions that Nirmohi Akhada should be given representation in the newly formed trust. Under this directive, Mahant Dinendra Das was made a trustee. Currently overseeing the Ram Mandir Trust Significant changes have been made in the Trust after the Ram Mandir donation theft. The entire responsibility of VIP passes and entry arrangements of the Mandir has been entrusted to Mahant Dinendra Das. Earlier, this arrangement was with Champat Rai and Anil Mishra. This means all passes issued for entry into the Temple are being approved only through the digital ID created in the name of Mahant Dinendra Das. Had expressed displeasure over donation theft After the Ram Mandir donation theft case came to light, Dinendra Das openly expressed his anger. He said - Those who tamper with God's offerings should not be forgiven. They should receive strict punishment like the death penalty. He assured that Ramlala's gold and silver ornaments are completely safe. Now know about Nirmohi Akhada... Nirmohi Akhada is the main Bairagi Akhada of the Ramanandi Vaishnav sect. It has been one of the most important parties in the Ram Janmabhoomi dispute in Ayodhya. Due to this, it has played a major role in the Ram Mandir movement and the legal battle fought in court. Currently, Nirmohi Akhada also has representation in the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, with Mahant Dinendra Das being a member on its behalf.
